_about: Public-domain Lewis French Stearns (1847-1892), professor of systematic theology at Bangor Seminary, for the Word Hoard: The Evidence of Christian Experience (the Ely Lectures for 1890), Present Day Theology, and his life of Henry Boynton Smith. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 109 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

lfstearns-evidence: The evidence of Christian experience : being the Ely lectures for 1890 (New York : C. Scribner's Sons, 1890)
lfstearns-present-day: Present day theology : a popular discussion of leading doctrines of the Christian faith (New York : C. Scribner, 1893)
